name: @atlitos/api
description: Typed Supabase client factory and domain hooks for every Atlitos app. Wraps every v1 services/api.ts function in a typed hook with the same name (docs/architecture/API-MAPPING.md) so screens do not change when a mock swaps for the real PostgREST/RPC/edge function call.

scripts.dev: echo "@atlitos/api has no standalone dev server, it is consumed by every app"
scripts.build: echo "@atlitos/api ships as source, no build step until an app bundler needs one"
